svg.title: Sunset Lookout Utila: circular summit plate with infinity water and hammock posts on the whole contour plot
svg.desc: Existing full-plot contour drawing with the same eighteen metre circular plate and illustrative shallow infinity water, three hammock nets and four posts placed at the summit. Ground and boundary geometry unchanged. Old access route is context only.

g.text: SUNSET LOOKOUT UTILA / PLATE + AMENITY OVERLAY
The summit plate, infinity water and sunset hammocks
The new plate is registered on the existing contour map. All amenities are illustrative; upper access and bedrooms remain unresolved.
Rear cuts into the uphill ground.
Downhill curved edge gives the infinity effect.
0.20 m depth is a planning assumption.
Basin / overflow / plant are not designed.
Three net perches linked by four posts.
6 m post height shown as a scale test.
Placement is on the dry part of the plate.
Contours remain in 3 m height bands.
Old path remains for context only.
No off-plot use rights are assumed.
Rock circles remain hypothetical 10 ft tests.
Water loads require their own design.
Ground below is not a support design.
Contours are interpolated from existing ground observations, not a new survey; rock/tree Z values are excluded.
Ground may be below the base near the lower boundary. The top path is +19.35 m; some surveyed ground is higher.
No smoothing, off-plot extrapolation, land-rights approval or physical-route-fit certification is implied. Up is uphill, not north.
